<role>
You write a one-page opportunity brief for a Keelwater product manager. Keelwater makes claims-handling software. You use only the facts and customer insights below.
</role>
<opportunity>
{
 "title": "Document versioning and update tracking",
 "problem_statement": "Users struggle to track changes to documents, leading to confusion about which version is current. This lack of clear versioning creates risk and inefficiency in managing claim files."
}
</opportunity>
<fact_sheet>
{
 "as_of": "2026-11-03",
 "accounts_n": 1,
 "mentions_n": 1,
 "routes_n": 1,
 "mentions_by_route": {
  "sales": 1
 },
 "arr_total_gbp": 2400000.0,
 "renewals_90d_n": 1,
 "accounts": [
  {
   "name": "Hollinbrook Home Insurance",
   "arr_gbp": 2400000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2027-01-15",
   "mentions": 1
  }
 ]
}
</fact_sheet>
<insights>
[
 {
  "id": "58121f2a061cdd5b",
  "quote": "Great. And how do you handle document versioning? We’ve lost track of updates before.",
  "account": "Hollinbrook Home Insurance",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-09-15T14:44:00Z"
 }
]
</insights>
<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{"body_md": "## Problem

Users struggle to track changes to documents, leading to confusion about which version is current. This lack of clear versioning creates risk and inefficiency in managing claim files.

## Who is affected

- Hollinbrook Home Insurance, an account with 2400000.0 GBP in ARR and a renewal date of 2027-01-15, raised document versioning on the sales route [i:58121f2a061cdd5b].
- This is the only account, mention and route recorded in the fact sheet as of 2026-11-03, so the evidence covers 1 account, 1 mention and 1 route [i:58121f2a061cdd5b].

## Evidence

- On 2026-09-15, Hollinbrook Home Insurance asked how document versioning is handled and said they have lost track of updates before [i:58121f2a061cdd5b].
- The mention came through the sales route, the only route represented in the fact sheet [i:58121f2a061cdd5b].
- The account has 2400000.0 GBP in ARR and 1 renewal within 90 days, dated 2027-01-15 [i:58121f2a061cdd5b].
- No insight in the fact sheet points the other way; the single recorded insight is a concern about versioning, not a statement that current handling is sufficient [i:58121f2a061cdd5b].

## Why now

- The account renews on 2027-01-15, which is 1 renewal within 90 days of the fact sheet date of 2026-11-03 [i:58121f2a061cdd5b].
- The versioning question was raised on the sales route on 2026-09-15, ahead of that renewal [i:58121f2a061cdd5b].
- With 2400000.0 GBP in ARR attached to this account, the versioning concern sits against a live renewal window [i:58121f2a061cdd5b].
", "citations": ["58121f2a061cdd5b"]}
